text: The National Disaster Risk Management Fund (NDRMF) is a government-owned, not-for-profit company in Pakistan, established to finance and catalyze pre-disaster risk reduction, preparedness, and risk financing solutions. It operates by providing up to 70% grant co-financing for structural and non-structural measures, focusing on ex-ante interventions such as planning, preparedness, early warning, and mitigation, while excluding post-disaster response activities.
